notes.title: DEVELOPER JOURNAL #2 - The New Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there![/h2][p]     Some of you had a chance to play an early Steam version of [b]I Hate This Place[/b] during From Poland With Love event.
 Since then, we had created a new version to showcase during Gamescom 2025, but we doubt all interested people managed to get to our booth and experience the game hands-on. [b]That's why we are releasing a brand new public Demo build for you![/b]  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeYZ9CpPv79fkcYUp1oc2InY8kcaRrFRJN8-1NhHZFx4mDdETZkez7H0xXc6v1IvYWiKPxDQQ1PID_isHmOpLm4cOaT54F0ov1bEmbGhyCl5FiYGCIrvwSLxjKxEGdN720q0kC5?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/bff3cdbfd54d40ec2cce8142a6d64ddb93953148.png"][/img][/p][p]     You may be woindering - but why should I play this demo version if I have played the previous one already? Well, simple- [b]because it's very different![/b]  

In this demo version of I Hate This Place, you will be able to:[/p][list][*][p]Explore a brand new area of the game with unexplored rooms and other mysteries.[/p][/*][*][p]Familiarize yourself better with the in-game crafting system [/p][/*][*][p]Fight some more monsters from the crazy I Hate This Place universe    
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/4a8db8b42adc924a3b35fb35181db7fe1b07e7e5.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd8hH-Wp92YoqaLiw9YdWRDV4R7ftWYyV9pFWBQTSf9JkW6oKx0SVyoV4coUjGfiuuaznSp-cuAHDIsb5pnudj0bBe6uYzu-ZfTaDHAL-2WqbvwADOlrqzLqO8fqMJK8p8DGmkvHg?key=se1S4p88HTyidRgTZoWTbA"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Got you interested? Play the demo NOW![/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604490/I_Hate_This_Place/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for all your continuous outpouring of support and love - you give us motivation each day to keep improving the game further. You are awesome! 🖤[/p][p]

notes.title: I Hate This Place with an overhauled Steam Page!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome![/h1][p]With a new Gameplay Trailer out (if you haven't watched it, [b][u][url="https://youtu.be/BtgCRwEvVsI"]see it here![/url][/u][/b]), we thought it would also be a good idea to rehaul our Steam page![/p][p][/p][h2]To start of, we got a new keyart highlighting our fearless protagonist Elena![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/9e862721d398458bdae0672ca2e4051be01663f4.png"][/img][/p][h3]Since the development of I Hate This Place is moving faster and faster everyday, [b]some Screenshots and GIFs needed an update to illustrate the growth of the game itself![/b] [/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/f1d8c02df6b96181428464c15bb0cca4e3176c71.jpg"][/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/e5bb37ebaabd3029dfc9b8744336660eb7d46d9b.gif"][/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/ba4ed55605d7baee6f8fc37d2ed63cd3061440a8.jpg"][/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549052/78b5c5903d10011cbf4050ec39ee3e6f0f53379f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]To all our Ukrainian friends and fans[/b] - from now on, you can also view our page in your native language 💛💙
Outside of Ukrainian support, we have also localized our page to [b]Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Swedish, Turkish, Czech and more[/b]! [/p][h3][b]
If you want to see all the changes, go ahead to our Steam page and wishlist I Hate This Place when you are at it :)[/b] [/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604490/I_Hate_This_Place/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for all your continuous outpouring of support and love - you give us motivation each day to keep improving the game further. You are awesome! 🖤[/p][p]
[b][u]You can also follow us on Social Media :)[/u]
[/b][url="https://x.com/BMGhorrors" style="button" buttoncolor="#0064c2"]X/Twitter[/url]  | [url="https://www.facebook.com/people/Broken-Mirror-Games/61576569670277/"] [/url][url="https://www.facebook.com/people/Broken-Mirror-Games/61576569670277/" style="button" buttoncolor="#8ac0ff"]Facebook[/url]  |  [url="https://www.instagram.com/bmghorrors/" style="button" buttoncolor="#e100ff"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][/p]
